description: Demonstration scoring rules for the Sterile Sense AI prototype. RPN = Severity x Occurrence x Detection, each scored 1-10.
disclaimer: These thresholds are configurable examples chosen for this demonstration. They are not a universal regulatory requirement. Each organization defines its own risk acceptance criteria within its quality risk management process.
criticalSeverityRule: Any failure mode with Severity >= criticalSeverityThreshold is flagged high priority regardless of RPN, so high-severity risks are never hidden by a low RPN.

severity.9-10: Possible patient harm or regulatory action
severity.7-8: Batch or lot rejected, major deviation
severity.4-6: Rework or minor deviation, partial loss

detection.9-10: Almost certainly not detected before release or use
